# Vendored front-end libraries

| File | Source | License |
|------|--------|---------|
| `htm-preact.mjs` | `https://unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.module.js` (htm 3.1.1 bundled with Preact 10 and hooks) | htm: Apache-2.0, Preact: MIT |

Files are committed as downloaded so the console works without network
access or a build step. To upgrade, download the new version to the same path.
